_about: Free Flow's speech model catalog. The app, the setup picker and Settings > Models render whatever is listed here: add a model by adding an entry (and its files to App/Resources/model-manifest.json). downloadBytes must equal the manifest bytes of the model plus its tokenizer (ModelCatalogTests checks). minMemoryGiB: below it the model shows as too big and cannot be picked (ProcessInfo.physicalMemory in GiB; an 8 GB device reports about 7.5). recommendFromGiB: smallest memory the automatic pick considers it from, null = never picked automatically. preference: among the models the automatic pick considers, the highest wins. languageCodes: ISO 639-1 codes the model covers, null = Whisper's full set. quality: only a number measured on this exact file, with who measured it and when, else null. C++ models (engine ggml-*) run on FreeFlowEngine (llama.cpp + whisper.cpp Parakeet on one ggml): family groups the quantizations of one model; quant names the file's quantization; modelFile / projectorFile are the file names inside the model's manifest entry (projectorFile = the audio projector of an audio LLM); systemPrompt makes an audio LLM transcribe; peakMemoryMB = peak memory footprint (phys_footprint, MiB: what iOS counts against the app's memory limit) measured with this file on the Mac CPU with the app's engine build: the highest of 100 short clips and one 201 s and one 768 s recording, used with os_proc_available_memory for 'won't run well'; null = not measured, and a C++ file without it is never RECOMMENDED. For C++ models recommendFromGiB and preference pick the quantization within the family; the automatic pick for the whole app stays on Core ML until the C++ engine is measured to match it on device. quality.source: measured = we ran this exact file; vendor = the maker's published number. groups: the sections of the Models page (one model and every size, quantization and engine Free Flow can run it with); each model names its group. quant on a Core ML model says how its weights are stored, read from the files' Core ML metadata (storagePrecision). simSpeed: audio seconds / processing seconds of this exact file in the UI test walk (FreeFlowUITests.test2, JFK clip) on an iOS simulator on the Mac, shown only as a simulator number; null = not measured.

groups.blurb: NVIDIA's Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 and its 2026 re-trainings: English and 24 other European languages on the Neural Engine, plus a C++ backup.

groups.name: Underdog Bark 3.0
groups.blurb: Conway Research's English post-trainings of Parakeet: Clean leaves out “um” and false starts, Pro writes every word.

groups.name: Whisper
groups.blurb: OpenAI's Whisper on the Neural Engine (Core ML by Argmax): 99 languages, and it leaves out most “um”s and false starts on its own.
